lines.en: I cast no shadow when I walk.
I move along the wall without touching the floor.

lines.zh: 我走得很像它，但差一点。
lines.en: I walk like it does, but not quite.
My footsteps dissolve in the mist.
I circle you; you needn't fear me.
I approach step by step, then retreat.
My outline keeps trembling.
I cross from one side of the door to the other.
My mist is paler than the real thing.
I lift my head; the shape doesn't line up.
I go slowly, afraid of falling apart.
I stopped behind you.
I stand as if waiting for you.
My form quivers in the air.

lines.zh: 我站在你窗子外面，不吭声
lines.en: I stand outside your window, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 我没有体温，也没有呼吸。
lines.en: I have no warmth and no breath.
Mist slides off my shoulder.
I raise a hand; half of it disperses.
I have appeared in your dreams.

lines.zh: 我不需要做什么，只是站着。
lines.en: I need do nothing but stand.
My eye sockets are hollow all the way through.
The more you look, the clearer I become.
I slowly gather into a shape.

lines.zh: 我留在地上的影子不是你的
lines.en: The shadow I leave on the ground is not yours.

lines.zh: 我照它的样子站着，学得很像。
lines.en: I stand as it does, copying well.

lines.zh: 我脚下的雾比真正的薄。
lines.en: The mist at my feet is thinner than the real one.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，我正在高兴。
lines.en: You see me, and I am glad.
Don't be afraid; I cannot touch you.
I lift my head; my face has no features.

lines.zh: 你确认一下，我是不是真的。
lines.en: Check whether I am real.

lines.zh: 我离你这么近，你却没感觉。
lines.en: I am this close and you feel nothing.
If you look straight at me, I come apart.
I tilt my head the way it does.
Don't raise your lamp too high.
I am here, and not here.
I cannot hear your heartbeat.
I smile, very faintly.
Blink, and I am gone.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候我换了个位置。
lines.en: I moved while you blinked.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，五根手指是散的。
lines.en: I raise a hand; its five fingers are loose.
Don't look at me too long.

lines.zh: 我在你眼角，不在正前方。
lines.en: I am at the corner of your eye, not ahead.
My outline is smearing upward.
You cannot count my shadow.

lines.zh: 我被光一照，边缘就没了。
lines.en: Light hits me and my edges vanish.
I scatter into a patch of mist.
That thinned me a great deal.
I gathered back a little.
You struck empty air.
I wavered and my shape bent.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓抖得快要散了
lines.en: My outline shivers, close to coming apart.
I am turning transparent.

lines.zh: 打在我身上，只掉下一点雾
lines.en: Strike me and only a little mist comes away.
I quietly shed a piece of myself.
You hold a lamp; I am somewhat afraid.
Don't point that light at me.
I reach out and come apart.

lines.zh: 你看，我连这个都拿不动。
lines.en: See? I cannot even lift this.

lines.zh: 你要给我什么？我看不清。
lines.en: What are you giving me? I can't see clearly.

lines.zh: 光晃过来，我的脸就糊了
lines.en: The light swings over and my face smears out.
The light is too strong; my edges are melting.
Come closer and I must retreat.

lines.zh: 这果子在雾里，我尝不出味
lines.en: In the mist, the fruit has no taste for me.
Keep it; I can't lift it.
I scatter, and the mist slowly gathers again.
I have no weight.
Your hand passed through.
Let us call that a collision.

lines.zh: 雾沾在你袖子上，一会儿就没。
lines.en: Mist clings to your sleeve, then fades.
I pass through your body.
Don't chase me; I will scatter.
I withdraw and my shape gathers again.
You shivered.
I hit the wall and passed halfway through.
I don't even have blood.

lines.zh: 我只是它留下的一个影子。
lines.en: I am only a shadow it left behind.

lines.zh: 你对着我说话，没有人应。
lines.en: You speak to me and no one answers.
I will stay by you a little while.
I lean on the wall, quiet.
You needn't remember me.

lines.zh: 明天的我就不是今天这个了。
lines.en: Tomorrow's me won't be today's.

lines.zh: 我伸手，手指碰到你的脸就散了。
lines.en: I reach out; my fingers scatter at your cheek.
This is not real.
I withdraw, and the mist follows.
My hand cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 它从我的指缝里掉下去。
lines.en: It falls through my fingers.
I try to lift it.
No. Too solid.
I touch it once and pull back.
It has no weight in my hand.
Never mind. I cannot lift it.
You pick it up; I'll watch.
I blew, and it moved.

lines.zh: 我的手指从它中间穿了过去
lines.en: My fingers slide straight through it.
I did not come to fight you.
I stand here so you will see me.
It sends me out first.
You cannot strike me down.
I only want you to run.

lines.zh: 你回头了，我的任务完成了。
lines.en: You looked back. My task is done.
You go back; I come forward.
I strike nothing; I only appear.
I raise a hand and you begin to shake.
I count to three, and you will run.
Seeing me is enough.
I am only trying to frighten you.
It had me stand in the middle of the path.
I raise a hand only to make you stop.
When I appear, the lamp dims.

lines.zh: 你回头，我的事就做完了。
lines.en: When you look back, my work is done.
I follow and never touch you.

lines.zh: 你迈哪只脚，我就跟着迈
lines.en: Whichever foot you lead with, I follow.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的慢了半拍。
lines.en: My shadow lags yours by half a beat.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我正贴着墙站着
lines.en: Turn around and I am pressed against the wall.
My mist grows thinner.

lines.zh: 我的边角已经开始发淡了
lines.en: My edges have already begun to fade.
Run a little longer.
I wait at the corner.
When you blink, I move.
I will not hurt you. Truly.
Mist spreads from my feet.
One glance is all I need.

lines.zh: 我一直在原地，是你自己在转。
lines.en: I never moved; you are the one turning.

lines.zh: 我快维持不住这个形状了。
lines.en: I can hardly hold this shape.
Don't shout; no one will answer.

lines.zh: 我从墙里露出半个身子。
lines.en: Half of me shows through the wall.
The mist is borrowed.
I have followed you without a sound.
I truly cannot touch you.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍下去，拍在墙上
lines.en: I swing at you and strike the wall.
That was only cold air.

lines.zh: 我挠你，你只感到一阵冷。
lines.en: I rake at you; you only feel a chill.
I push you and you don't move.
Mist rushes into your face.
I lunge and scatter myself.
That one was empty.
Don't be afraid; I am very light.
I grab your shadow.
I catch nothing.
I scatter and gather behind you.

lines.zh: 我抓你的手，只抓到空气。
lines.en: I swipe at your hand and catch only air.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵冷，然后什么也没有。
lines.en: You feel a chill, then nothing.
I scatter as I lunge.
It doesn't hurt; it only frightens.
I first gather shape in a corner.

lines.zh: 雾从地上升起来，成了我。
lines.en: Mist rises from the ground and becomes me.
I open my eyes; there are no pupils.
It is near, so I am too.
I stood a while before anyone came.
This time I chose the doorway.

lines.zh: 我的影子先于身体出现。
lines.en: My shadow appears before my body.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，我站在光外面。
lines.en: The lamp is lit; I stand outside the light.
I have not decided whom to resemble.

lines.zh: 你听见雾里的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the sound in the mist?
I condense a little.
I come from the other side.
If you run, I will be pleased.

lines.zh: 路两头都静，我挑中间站
lines.en: Both ends of the road are quiet; I take the middle.
My landing makes no sound.
I wait to see you look back.
My shape sagged for a moment.
The wind thinned me.
Fire nears and I become smoke.

lines.zh: 我掉下去的时候已经很淡了。
lines.en: By the time I fell I was already faint.
Water splashes, and I scatter entirely.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我撕成几缕
lines.en: The blast tears me into a few wisps.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，我身上多了个洞
lines.en: The arrow goes through and leaves a hole in me.

lines.zh: 咒光一亮，我的形状被冲开。
lines.en: Spell-light flares and my shape is torn open.

lines.zh: 没有活人的气息，我快没了。
lines.en: Without a living presence, I am fading.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我就剩下轮廓。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and only my outline remains.
The void stretches me thin.
